notes.title: Big update on the demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704709/d33c66831a98c0335373fc95a41582ce4e9ce824.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]The demo has been updated![/b][/h3]

Hey everyone, the demo of R Body Adventure has been updated and you can finally fight the boss known as [b]Magnetizor[/b]! The AI of the robots have also been updated and the fights are "smoother".

You can also change R Body's color in case you don't like the blue, and a trophy system was implemented.
As you progress through the game, you will gain trophies that symbolize what you achieved, they can all be seen in Flexy's workshop.

[h3][b]Patch Notes – Demo Update🚀[/b][/h3]

We’re excited to announce a significant update to the demo! Here’s what’s new and improved:

🛠 [b]Robot Improvements[/b]

A-Bots, B-Bots, and C-Bots: Enhanced AI and combat behavior for a more engaging and strategic experience.

🎨 [b]New Customization System[/b]

Added a customization system allowing you to personalize R Body's main color, if you aren't fan of the blue, choose your favorite color!

🦾 [b]New Boss: Magnetizor[/b]

The formidable Magnetizor has been implemented. Discover its mechanics and take it down!

🎵 [b]New Music Tracks[/b]

Fresh music tracks have been added to enhance the game’s atmosphere. These musics aren't final and will most likely change at the game's release.

🏆 [b]New Trophy System[/b]

Trophies are now available! As you progress through the game, you will earn trophies that symbolize your achievements.
All your trophies can be viewed in Flexy’s Workshop, your hub for showing off accomplishments.

🇫🇷 [b]French Translation[/b]

The demo is now fully translated in French.

We hope you enjoy these improvements. Don’t hesitate to share your feedback! 💬
